note: custom_field_viewfield is a submodule of custom_field. It registers plugins INTO custom_field's plugin managers (it defines no new plugin type): CustomFieldType 'viewfield' (a column with target_type: view), CustomFieldWidget 'viewfield_select', CustomFieldFormatter 'viewfield_default', and a CustomFieldFeedsType 'viewfield'. A viewfield column lives in a 'custom' field's storage 'columns' setting; the widget/formatter are chosen per column under the Custom Field widget/formatter component's settings.fields.<column>. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that live config on a namespaced content type cf_vf_eval with the Custom Field field_cf_vf (viewfield column 'listing'), read/written via field.storage + entity_form_display. Requires custom_field + core views (both enabled here).

evals.prompt: In the Drupal module custom_field_viewfield (a Custom Field submodule), what Custom Field plugin ids does it add so you can embed a View inside a custom field column? Name the field-type, widget and formatter ids.
evals.expected_output: It registers a CustomFieldType 'viewfield' (the column type, target_type: view), a CustomFieldWidget 'viewfield_select', a CustomFieldFormatter 'viewfield_default', and a CustomFieldFeedsType 'viewfield' — all consumed inside a parent 'custom' field.

evals.prompt: How is a viewfield subfield stored when using custom_field_viewfield? Where in the field configuration does the 'viewfield' column live, and what target_type does it use?
evals.expected_output: It is a column inside a normal 'custom' field's storage setting: field.storage.<entity>.<field>.settings.columns.<name> = {type: viewfield, target_type: view}. It is not a standalone field type.

evals.prompt: custom_field_viewfield is a submodule. What does it depend on, and is it a standalone field or part of another field?
evals.expected_output: It depends on custom_field and core views. It is not a standalone field type — it adds a 'viewfield' subfield/column plus its widget and formatter to the Custom Field plugin system.

evals.prompt: On this site the content type cf_vf_eval has a Custom Field named field_cf_vf. One of its subfield columns is a viewfield. Inspect the live field storage and give the machine name of the viewfield column.
evals.expected_output: The column 'listing' has type viewfield (target_type: view) in field.storage.node.field_cf_vf settings.columns.

evals.prompt: On this site, the 'listing' viewfield column of the Custom Field field_cf_vf on content type cf_vf_eval has a subfield widget configured on the default form display. Inspect the live form display and state which Custom Field widget is used for that column.
evals.expected_output: The 'listing' column uses widget viewfield_select — in core.entity_form_display.node.cf_vf_eval.default the field_cf_vf component settings.fields.listing.type is viewfield_select.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a content type cf_vf_eval but no Custom Field on it yet. Using custom_field and custom_field_viewfield, create a Custom Field named field_cf_vf on cf_vf_eval whose storage has a viewfield column (so it can embed a View). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create field storage field.storage.node.field_cf_vf of type 'custom' whose settings.columns contains a column with type 'viewfield' (target_type: view), plus a field instance on cf_vf_eval.

evals.prompt: On this site the Custom Field field_cf_vf on cf_vf_eval has a viewfield column 'listing' whose subfield widget on the default form display is currently 'hidden'. Change that subfield's widget to the viewfield select widget provided by custom_field_viewfield, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.cf_vf_eval.default set the field_cf_vf component settings.fields.listing.type to viewfield_select.
